exposure: acute colonic pseudo-obstruction (ACPO) after cesarean section
outcome: Irritable Bowel Syndrome - Severity Scoring System (IBS-SSS) score
Rome IV criteria for irritable bowel syndrome
The MOS 36-item Short-Form Health Survey (SF-36) score
Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) score
cohort: 25 women who developed ACPO after cesarean section (cases) and 37 women who did not (controls)
finding: While women who developed ACPO after cesarean section experienced a greater degree of deterioration in gastrointestinal symptoms compared to controls, there was no significant difference in long-term gastrointestinal symptom prevalence between the two groups.
